topic: What if Earth had rings + backup topics

variants.name: rings-thin-arc
variants.image_prompt: A quiet suburban street at golden hour seen from the sidewalk. High in the sky a very thin, delicate, slightly translucent pale-gold arc of Earth's planetary ring stretches from horizon to horizon, far away and faint like a band of sunlit dust, partly softened by atmospheric haze, its ends disappearing behind distant rooftops and trees. Ordinary everyday scene, people would barely notice it. Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, shot on a full-frame camera with a 24mm lens, natural light, realistic atmospheric haze, high dynamic range, sharp details.

variants.name: rings-twilight
variants.image_prompt: A wide valley with a small town at dusk, the landscape already in blue shadow while high above, Earth's ring system still catches the sunlight and glows as a brilliant thin silver-white arc across the darkening sky, crossed by a dark gap where Earth's shadow falls on it. The arc fades into haze near the horizon on both sides behind mountains. Inspired by scientific visualizations of Earth with rings. Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, shot on a full-frame camera with a 24mm lens, natural light, realistic atmospheric haze, high dynamic range, sharp details.

variants.name: rings-mountain-view
variants.image_prompt: View from a mountain ridge over a vast landscape of forests and lakes at noon. Across the pale blue sky runs a giant but distant ring arc of Earth, made of fine striped bands of white and beige, partly transparent so the blue sky shows through, getting thinner and fainter toward the horizon where it vanishes behind far mountain ranges in the haze. Realistic scale, NASA-like realism. Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, shot on a full-frame camera with a 24mm lens, natural light, realistic atmospheric haze, high dynamic range, sharp details.

variants.name: rings-beach
variants.image_prompt: A tropical beach near the equator at sunrise, palm trees in the foreground. Earth's ring seen almost edge-on rises straight up from the horizon as a narrow bright luminous band that splits the sky, thin and sharp like a beam of light, reflected in the calm sea, fading into the haze at the horizon behind the palms. Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, shot on a full-frame camera with a 24mm lens, natural light, realistic atmospheric haze, high dynamic range, sharp details.

Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, shot on a full-frame camera with a 24mm lens, natural light, realistic atmospheric haze, high dynamic range, sharp details.

variants.image_prompt: A beach at night with waves crashing onto the sand glowing electric blue from bioluminescent plankton, bright neon-blue foam lines on the dark water and blue glowing footprints in the wet sand, a starry sky, very realistic long-lens night photo.
